Between [[3636 BBY]] and [[3630 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Manaan/Legends|Manaan]] was '''occupied''' during the [[Eternal Empire]]'s attacks on the [[The galaxy/Legends|known galaxy]]. The occupation caused a galaxy-wide resource shortage, increased demand for medical substances such as [[Kolto/Legends|kolto]], which was harvested from Manaan's [[Ocean/Legends|oceans]].<ref name="Codex" />

==Behind the scenes==
The occupation of Manaan was first mentioned in the codex entry "Manaan Visitor's Center: Exploration Dome" which was released in Game Update 7.1: ''Digging Deeper'', released on [[August 2]], [[2022]], as part of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith]]'',<ref name="TORweb">{{TORweb|url=info/news/article/20220802|text=Game Update 7.1 "Digging Deeper" is live!}}</ref> the eighth digital expansion to the [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]].<ref name="Announcement">{{TORweb|url=info/news/article/20210701|text=Announcing Legacy of the Sith, the next expansion for Star Wars: The Old Republic}}</ref>
